1 · Intro

When to use it.

Add Assignment gives a person a second job inside the work relationship they already have. The first job keeps running; the new one gets its own position, hours, salary, and manager.

Use it when the person already has an employee (E) assignment. If they only have an enrolled student (N) record, you add the employment work relationship instead.

Use this whenAn employee already in Oracle is taking on a second job in addition to the one they have.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Each assignment has its own costing, hours, and pay. Review costing for the new assignment; blank costing means it uses the work unit default.
  • Changing which assignment is primary affects what shows as the person's main job. Change it only on purpose.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's action reasons for an added assignment and whether a second assignment needs a pre-approval from Compensation or your PCB consultant.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Assignment Changes

Add Assignment

Use when: An employee already in Oracle is taking on a second job in addition to the one they have. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Confirm the person already has an active employee (E) assignment.
    • E assignment: add an assignment
    • N record only: add the work relationship
  2. Confirm the position for the new job exists and is correct.
  3. Open Add Assignment from Our Workforce > Quick Actions.
  4. Enter the When and why: start date and action reason.
  5. Enter the assignment: position, hours, and primary flag.
    • Only one assignment can be primary
  6. Enter salary and payroll details for the new assignment.
  7. Review, submit, and track approval.

Watch-outs

  • Each assignment has its own costing, hours, and pay. Review costing for the new assignment; blank costing means it uses the work unit default.
  • Changing which assignment is primary affects what shows as the person's main job. Change it only on purpose.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's action reasons for an added assignment and whether a second assignment needs a pre-approval from Compensation or your PCB consultant.
